description: This is a test source file for a software project that tests various download functionalities using pytest. It defines a test class with multiple test cases covering download scenarios such as sequential, parallel, large files, reusing connections, pausing/resuming, failure cases, speed limits, and protocol-specific behaviors.

classes.name: TestDownload
classes.description: A class containing pytest-based test cases to validate various download scenarios, protocol handling, connection reuse, pausing/resuming, speed limit, and error handling in a curl-based testing environment.
